verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS compliance platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing showing ComplyAdvantage's source code is available under any open license. The publicly retrievable OpenAPI schema, Postman collection and llms.txt are API documentation, not product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
